scenarios.name: Open and close customization while one face is selected

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part with a solid body is active in the MCAD Software
the Tools ribbon tab is selected
the user opens Customize from the Tools ribbon
the customization dialog opens on the Ribbon tab
the command category is All Commands
the target is Part Tools with an empty custom panel list
Close is available while Cancel and Apply are disabled
the user closes customization without making changes
the selection indicator reports one face
